To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a fine-grained, distributed methodology to support domain experts to engineer and evolve their ontologies by means of a model that is based on Rhetoric Structure Theory.

the DILIGENTS methodology can be applied to the engineering of ontologies, and that it supports distributed, loosely controlled ontology engineering processes in the sense of the DILIGIENT ontology engineering model.

1) The DILIGENT approach can be applied to the development of ontologies in distributed, loosely-controlled settings; 2) It is possible to apply the DILIGENTS approach in a fine-grained manner, and 3) It is possible and feasible to support the DILIGENS approach with an appropriate ontology engineering environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (1) how can we support the ontology engineering process in truly distributed environments, (2) how can we provide a fine-grained, methodologically sound support to ontology engineers, and (3) how can we ensure that the methodology is applicable in a variety of different application domains?
the following questions: How can we support domain experts in the distributed development and maintenance of ontologies?
the question of how the DILIGENTS model can be used as a basis for a methodology that supports the distributed engineering of ontologies in the Semantic Web.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DILIGENT is a methodology to support the distributed and loosely-controlled evolution of ontologies by means of argumentation.
we present the DILIGENTS model of ontology engineering as an approach for the distributed engineering of ontologies in a peer-to-peer setting.

the DILIGENTS methodology is a fine-grained, distributed and loosely-controlled methodology for the engineering and evolution of ontologies, based on argumentation, that supports the domain experts in a truly distributed and loosely-controlled setting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are developing a methodology that is based on a formalization of the ontology engineering process and that is supported by a software tool, which is able to guide domain experts through the engineering process by means of a fine-grain argumentation model.

the methodology has been developed and tested, the ontology engineering by argument model has been implemented in the DILIGENTS system, the ontology editor Protege-OWL has been extended by an ontology engineering by argument plugin, and the methodology has been successfully applied to the ontology engineering process for the DILIGENt ontology itself.
we are currently in the process of implementing our model of ontology engineering, and have developed a first prototype that allows for the creation and management of argumentation-based ontologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a methodology for distributed, loosely-controlled and evolving ontology engineering should be based on a fine-grained approach, where the granularity level is determined by the rhetorical structure of the argumentation.
the DILIGENTS model of ontology engineering is a viable basis for the DILIGIENT methodology.
the distributed nature of the ontology engineering process may not be an impediment for the application of the methodology.
